1.climatology_source: leak-free mean change over the same horizon, from the pinned input the registry was issued from

note: Scores of the frozen forward registry. The scored forecast is no-change. The climatology columns score a reference point with the same spread: the leak-free mean change over the same horizon, from the pinned input the registry was issued from. A result is prospective only if the source published the target year after the registry's issue date (V-Dem publishes each March with data through the previous year); otherwise it is blind but retrospective. vintage_vs_pin compares the realized panel with the June 2026 pin on every year both hold.
